definitions.gloss: chest area; bosom; the area around the upper chest and neckline
definitions.explanation: The front of the body around the upper chest, especially where clothing opens or closes. Often refers to the area visible at the neckline of clothing.

examples.japanese: {胸元|むなもと}が{大|おお}きく{開|あ}いた{服|ふく}。
{胸元|むなもと}にブローチをつけた。
examples.english: I pinned a brooch to my chest.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{強|つよ}くて、{着物|きもの}の{胸元|むなもと}がはだけてしまった。
examples.english: The wind was so strong that the front of my kimono came open.

notes:
Composed of {胸|むな} (chest) + {元|もと} (area around). Refers specifically to the upper chest area, especially as it relates to clothing — the neckline, the opening of a shirt or kimono, or the area where accessories are worn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胸元|むなもと}が{開|あ}く: the neckline is open
- {胸元|むなもと}がはだける: the chest area comes undone
- {胸元|むなもと}を{正|ただ}す: to straighten one's collar/clothing
- {胸元|むなもと}に{手|て}を{当|あ}てる: to put one's hand to one's chest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {胸|むね}: chest — the general body part; {胸元|むなもと} focuses on the surface and clothing area
- {襟元|えりもと}: collar area — specifically the area around the collar of clothing
- {喉元|のどもと}: throat area — the front of the neck, slightly higher than {胸元|むなもと}
